description: Light athlete (50kg female) — short easy 30-min run. Minimal fueling; tests degenerate low-target case.
knownFailureReason: GENUINE ALGORITHM PARITY VIOLATION: Rule solver cannot deliver fluid below its minimum serving floor (1 water serving = 240ml + 1 sports drink serving = 240ml = 480ml min). Small fluid targets (300ml) can never be satisfied because min_servings=1 on all catalog liquids. The solver overshoots fluid by ~60% on short workouts.
